shell.changelog: Beta 0.2.0-beta.9: Safe area (viewport-fit=cover and env(safe-area-inset-*)) for shell, browser, and launcher to prevent overlapping with top status bar and bottom gesture handle; fixed console dock sizing and overlapping behavior. Browser version 0.1.0-beta.3, console version 0.1.0-beta.2. Not yet verified on a physical device.
